actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.download_recording_media.descrip: Download a call recording as an audio file.
actions.download_recording_media.props.c: Dual keeps each caller on a separate channel, if recorded that way.
actions.download_recording_media.props.f: MP3 files are smaller. WAV keeps full quality.
actions.download_recording_media.props.r: Starts with RE. Shown in the New Recording trigger output.
actions.get_message.description: Get the status and details of a sent or received message.
actions.get_message.props.message_sid.de: Starts with SM or MM. Shown in the Send SMS output and Twilio logs.
actions.make_call.description: Call a number and read a message aloud.
actions.make_call.props.from.description: Your Twilio number the call comes from.
actions.make_call.props.language.descrip: Language the message is read in. Empty: English (US).
actions.make_call.props.message.descript: Text read aloud to the person who answers.
actions.make_call.props.sendDigits.descr: Keys pressed once the call connects. w pauses 0.5 s, W pauses 1 s.
actions.make_call.props.timeout.descript: Seconds to ring before giving up, up to 600. Empty: 60.
actions.make_call.props.to.description: Phone number with country code, starting with +.
actions.make_call.props.voice.descriptio: Empty: your Twilio account's default voice.
actions.phone_number_lookup.description: Look up the carrier and line type (mobile, landline) of a number.
actions.phone_number_lookup.props.phone_: Phone number with country code, starting with +.
actions.send_sms.description: Send an SMS from one of your Twilio numbers.
actions.send_sms.props.body.description: Up to 1,600 characters. Long texts are split and billed per part.
actions.send_sms.props.from.description: Your Twilio number the text is sent from.
actions.send_sms.props.to.description: Phone number with country code, starting with +.
auth.description:
To find your credentials:
1. Sign in to the [Twilio Console](https://console.twilio.com).
2. On the home page, find **Account Info**.
3. Copy the **Account SID** and the **Auth Token** (click **Show** to reveal it).
auth.password.description: Click Show under Account Info in the Twilio Console to reveal it.
auth.username.description: Starts with AC. Shown under Account Info in the Twilio Console.
description: Cloud communications platform for building SMS, Voice & Messaging applications
triggers.new_call.description: Triggers when a call completes (incoming or outgoing).
triggers.new_incoming_sms.description: Triggers when the selected Twilio number receives an SMS.
triggers.new_incoming_sms.props.phone_nu: Your Twilio number that receives the texts.
triggers.new_phone_number.description: Triggers when you add a new phone number to your account.
triggers.new_recording.description: Triggers when a new call recording is added to your account.
triggers.new_transcription.description: Triggers when a new call recording transcription is completed.
